svg.title: The Mackenzie Building of the Royal Military College of Canada on Point Frederick, Kingston, square on as photographed in 2007 and 2008: a long, symmetrical three-storey building of grey limestone in the Second Empire manner, with a mansard roof band of weathered green carrying a row of arched dormers, a taller projecting pavilion at each end under its own steep green mansard with a round oculus window, square-headed white-framed sash windows in a regular rhythm, and the TALL CENTRAL CLOCK TOWER rising in stages from an arched door to a dark slate mansard roof carrying a round white clock face and two small dormers, with a flat top. BUILDINGS ONLY: no cadet or figure of any kind, no crest, badge, coat of arms or carved device (the real carving over the door and in the tower is left as plain stone), no flag or flagstaff (OQ-ART-04), no memorial arch, no lettering. Drawn from assets/refs/kingston/rmc-mackenzie-building-elevation-2007.jpg (a night exposure, used for geometry only), with colour from rmc-mackenzie-building-daylight-2008.jpg. Every colour is from palette.json. See assets/refs/references.json, subject royal-military-college. POI hero, present at every visual tier.
